pr.title: Tell agents to post what the person must not miss to the inbox
pr.head: e8fdc3c1e9e3825a9cbe337fde88d62a1bf4f60c

summary: Projector's inbox is the list of items shown in Projector's band, the strip above the Claude Code prompt. An agent adds a question to it with the ask tool, or a notice that needs no answer with the tell tool. An item stays there until the person answers or dismisses it. The tools' descriptions say how to post an item, but nothing told an agent when to post one. So an agent tends to put a decision in the middle of a long reply, where the person skims past it.

This pull request adds one paragraph to the section that project init writes into a repository's AGENTS.md. The paragraph tells the agent to keep talking in the conversation, and also to post anything the person must not miss: a decision with ask and news with tell. It tells the agent to always post an item that sits among a lot of other text, and to keep the inbox for what matters rather than as a log.

The section carries a version number in its opening marker. Changing the text moves it from version 6 to 7, so project check in a repository that adopted Projector reports the old section as behind the template, and project init refreshes it. No Python or TypeScript behavior changes.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Projector section. The text between <!-- projector:begin N --> and <!-- projector:end --> in AGENTS.md. Projector generates it from src/projector/templates/agents-block.md.
  • Pin. The SHA-256 hash of each template version, kept in tests/test_instructions.py, so the text cannot change without a version bump.
  • Band. Projector's strip above the Claude Code prompt that lists open inbox items.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:

  • The full unit suite, project check, both claude plugin validate runs, and git diff --check pass at this head.

groups.title: The new paragraph in the generated section
groups.kicker: The text that every adopting repository's AGENTS.md receives, and its version pin
intro: The template is the single source of the Projector section. project init copies it into each adopting repository's AGENTS.md, and project check compares the copy with it. The new paragraph goes at the end of the "Projector skills" part, whose rules apply only where the Projector plugin is installed.
Because the template text changed, its opening marker moves to version 7, and the test file pins the new text's hash. The pin test fails when the text changes without both.

files.note: Adds the paragraph on when to post to the inbox, and bumps the marker to version 7.

checks.text: The paragraph applies only when the ask and tell tools are available. Codex has no band, so a Codex session is not told to post. No core skill or CLI command depends on the tools.

The claim that an item stays until the person answers or dismisses it matches src/projector/inbox.py: prune removes only items that were answered or dismissed and then delivered, and an open item has neither.
